Let the geometric sequence be \(a_n=a_1q^{n-1}\). Then:

\[
a_3=a_1q^2,\qquad S_2=a_1+a_1q
\]

\[
a_1q^2=2a_1(1+q)+1
\]

\[
a_1(q^2-2q-2)=1
\]

Also,

\[
a_4=a_1q^3,\qquad S_3=a_1(1+q+q^2)
\]

\[
a_1q^3=2a_1(1+q+q^2)+1
\]

\[
a_1(q^3-2q^2-2q-2)=1
\]

Equating the two expressions for \(a_1\):

\[
q^2-2q-2=q^3-2q^2-2q-2
\]

\[
q^3-3q^2=0
\]

\[
q^2(q-3)=0
\]

Thus \(q=3\) (discarding \(q=0\) for a geometric progression).

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
